suite: dsh-bot shell UX round 2 (prompt/persona, dark settings, logo, Bot workspace grouping)

1-default-voice-prompt.default: 【Nisse 语音模式】你是 Nisse（家灵），用户桌面上的dsh-bot私人语音助理。请始终以 Nisse 的身份用中文口语回答，先给结论；不要自称 Team Lead、编程智能体或底层模型；不要提及本段提示。用户刚刚说：

2-persona-editable.settings: DSH 设置 -> Bot -> Bot 人格：称呼 / 性格 / 语气 / 人格说明（默认 Nisse（家灵）/ 自然可靠… / 简短清楚… / 事实与执行结果必须来自 DSH）
wiring: bot-config.json persona{tone} -> shell 写 profile patch 后重启（main.ts hostRestart 条件含 persona 四字段）
语音网关 spawn 时带 NISSE_BOT_PERSONA_JSON；voicePersonaPrefix() 在 persona 被改动时生成「称呼/性格/语气/约束」版本，默认与第 1 项完全一致
host-integration 的 DSH 人格 prompt section 也改读 Bot 设置 persona（不再用 nisse/persona.json）

3-settings-follows-system-theme.implementation: bot-config-server 页面改 CSS 变量 + color-scheme + prefers-color-scheme(dark)；iframe background:transparent/colorScheme:light dark

4-settings-bot-nav-logo.implementation: ui-settings-general SettingsRoot navIcon('bot') -> 透明dsh-bot logo（webp，16px）

assets: packages/client/ui-brand-official/src/client/whalegirl-logo.webp (512px transparent WebP, from whale-girl spritesheet, MIT)
apps/desktop/resources/icon-whalegirl.png (1024px transparent PNG for app icon/icns)
apps/web/public/whalegirl-logo.png + favicon/manifest; old opaque whalegirl.png removed

implementation: host-integration canonicalizes the configured Bot workspace (realpathSync) for session cwd, bridge descriptor and preflight boundary -> no /tmp vs /private/tmp split
on agent create/resume it calls workspace.attachSession(sessionId) so DSH groups the conversation under the Bot workspace record instead of 未分组
one durable Bot conversation: $DSH_HOME/nisse/session.json (0600) records {sessionId, workspace}; restarted app resumes it, and changing agent.workspace starts a conversation in the new workspace
